第43章 大佬会玩！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

新的技能再次出现。

许默总觉得，自己似乎是记住某种规律了。

此时，老枪刚好回来，许默的视线落在面前的石板上。

淡蓝色的系统扫描光幕在岩石表面一扫而过。

这块石头可不是许默随便挑的。

他早上修缮营地的时候，开启了洞察之眼，早就发现了这块石头。

没想到，今晚排上了用场。

【天然平板石，系统判定：可替代铁砧。当前剩余耐久：5/5。】

许默直接打开工具箱，放入木材石材。

随后，将一块铁矿石扔进壁炉之中，石板搭在边缘上。

火星四溅，刺耳的金属敲击声在死寂的荒原上格外突兀。

第一锤落下，生铁碎裂，化为一地黑渣。

第二次尝试，温度过高，刃口在成型瞬间直接崩毁。

平板石表面崩开两道深可见骨的裂纹，耐久暴跌至3/5。

旁边的方芸和老枪连大气都不敢喘。

许默的眼神却越发狂热且专注。

他深吸一口气，将石锤高高抡起，狠狠砸下第三锤。

【营地特性生效！】

“铮——！”

刺目的绿芒从工作台上轰然亮起，驱散了周围数米内的黑暗迷雾。

一把通体流转着冷厉寒光的铁质匕首静静躺在石板上。

就在这一刻，许默脑海中突然传来一阵奇异的悸动。

原本隐藏在身体深处的某种潜能像是被这声金属颤音彻底唤醒。

【属性技能生效！】

【锻造专精：赋予当前锻造物品额外词条。】

匕首的属性面板下方，赫然多出一行烫金的小字：

【附加属性：锋利+1（切割护甲效率提升30%）】。

许默看着刀锋，忍不住嘴角上扬。

他抓起这把极品匕首，刀刃在火光下折射出令人心悸的光。

然后，他随手拍下一张截图，直接扔进大群。

截图下方，只配了一行极其嚣张的文字。

“图纸没问题，是你们这群废物不会用。”

New skills appear again.

Xu Mo always felt that he seemed to have remembered a certain pattern.

At this time, Lao Qiang just returned, and Xu Mo's eyes fell on the stone slab in front of him.

The light blue system scanning light curtain swept across the rock surface.

Xu Mo didn't pick this stone casually.

When he was repairing the camp in the morning, he opened his eyes of insight and discovered this stone long ago.

Unexpectedly, it came in handy tonight.

[Natural flat stone, system judgment: can replace anvil.Current remaining durability: 5/5.】

Xu Mo directly opened the tool box and put in wood and stone.

Then, a piece of iron ore was thrown into the fireplace, and the stone slab was placed on the edge.

Sparks flew everywhere, and the harsh metal knocking sound was particularly abrupt in the dead wasteland.

When the first hammer fell, the pig iron shattered and turned into black slag.

In the second attempt, the temperature was too high and the cutting edge collapsed at the moment of forming.

Two deep cracks with bone visible appeared on the surface of the flat stone, and its durability plummeted to 3/5.

Fang Yun and Lao Qiang next to them didn't even dare to breathe.

Xu Mo's eyes became more fanatical and focused.

He took a deep breath, swung the stone hammer high, and slammed the third hammer down.

[Camp characteristics take effect!】

"Zheng——!"

A dazzling green light suddenly lit up from the workbench, dispelling the dark fog within a few meters of the surrounding area.

An iron dagger with a cold light flowing through it lay quietly on the stone slab.

At this moment, Xu Mo suddenly felt a strange throbbing in his mind.

A certain potential that was originally hidden deep in the body seemed to be completely awakened by this metallic vibrating sound.

[Attribute skills take effect!】

[Forging Specialization: Gives the current forged item additional entries.】

Under the dagger's attribute panel, there is a line of small gilded characters:

[Additional attributes: sharpness +1 (cutting armor efficiency increased by 30%)].

Xu Mo looked at the blade and couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.

He grabbed this superb dagger, and the blade reflected a heart-stopping light in the firelight.

Then, he casually took a screenshot and threw it directly into the crowd.

Below the screenshot, there is only one line of extremely arrogant text.

"There's nothing wrong with the blueprints, but you guys can't use them."
